agency: NC Department of Commerce and North Carolina Community College System Office
summary: In collaboration with the NC Department of Commerce and NC Community College System, the NC Office of Strategic Partnerships (OSP) evaluated the Finish Line Grants program and created a process evaluation that led to recommended practices which include surveys and responses from one or more representatives of every Finish Line Grant local partnership. Governor Cooper’s Office issued a [press release,](https://governor.nc.gov/news/press-releases/2022/08/19/governor-cooper-directs-new-federal-funding-further-support-postsecondary-students-and-new-teachers#:~:text=Through%20a%20partnership%20between%20the%20North%20Carolina%20Department,community%20college%20students%20in%20the%20past%20four%20years.) which announced additional federal funding for the Finish Line Grants program and mentions the OSP evaluation.
question: Are there practices that could improve operations, efficiency, or utilization of Finish Line Grants?
title: Finish Line Grants
purpose: Project results created a model and best practices guide for future efforts that support retention of college students seeking degree and/or credential completion.
deliverable: * [Recommended practices for local partnerships administering Finish Line Grants](https://www.commerce.nc.gov/media/6314/download?attachment)
